title: Last Seat to Yaba
tagline: One danfo, one seat, and everything you do on the way decides who walks into the party first.

conductor_friend.label: Conductor's friend
conductor_friend.tip: He is on your side. Haggling and LASTMA talk get easier.

left_out.label: Left out
left_out.tip: The conductor ignores you. Charm gets harder.

dry_seat.label: Dry seat
dry_seat.tip: Settled and calm. Wisdom gets easier.

soaked.label: Soaked
soaked.tip: Wet, cold and cranky. Charm gets harder.

on_step.label: Hanging on the step
on_step.tip: Both hands on the door. You cannot bluff right now.

loud.label: Known loudmouth
loud.tip: Bluffs land harder, but charm gets harder.

called_out.label: Called out
called_out.tip: Nobody believes you. Bluff is off the table.

broke.label: Short on cash
broke.tip: No money to throw around. Paying fast is off the table.

phone_alive.label: Phone alive
phone_alive.tip: Maps and backup. Shortcuts get easier.

phone_dead.label: Phone dead
phone_dead.tip: No maps, no backup. Shortcuts get harder.

bus_hero.label: Bus hero
bus_hero.tip: The whole bus cheers for you. Charm gets easier.

villain.label: Bus villain
villain.tip: The bus remembers. Charm gets harder.

downpour.label: Heavy rain
downpour.tip: Everything is slippery. Hustle gets harder.

text.default: Ojuelegba, 6:40 pm, rain loading in the sky. A danfo screams 'Yaba! Yaba! One seat remaining!' You and {rival} hit the door at the same moment. You are both headed to the same surprise party, and the doors close at 8.
text.coop: Ojuelegba, 6:40 pm, rain loading in the sky. A danfo screams 'Yaba! Yaba! Last seats!' You and {partner} are headed to the same surprise party and the doors close at 8. Get on together, or walk.

stakes.default: The last seat, and who walks into the party first.
stakes.coop: Getting both of you on before it leaves.

choices.label: Smile at the conductor: 'Oga, abeg, I dey rush'
Slide past the crowd and jump in
Shout 'I was here first!' for the whole stop to hear
Skip the shoving and pay the conductor first

recap.default: The conductor loves {winner}'s smile and waves them in. {loser} is left on the step with the rain starting.
recap.coop: The conductor loves your smiles and waves you both in.

recap.default: {winner} slides through the crowd and is inside before the door shuts. {loser} grabs the frame and rides the step.
recap.coop: You clear a path and haul each other in. It is not pretty.

recap.default: {winner} shouts the whole stop into silence. {loser} suddenly feels watched by forty people.
recap.coop: Your shouting clears the stop and the conductor lets you on, annoyed.

recap.default: {winner} calmly pays first and the conductor waves them to the dry seat. {loser} is still arguing at the door.
recap.coop: You pay first, calmly, and the conductor waves you to the dry seats.

recap.default: You were both still posturing when the danfo pulled off, spraying muddy water over your shoes.
recap.coop: You were still arguing about who goes first when the danfo pulled off and soaked your shoes.

tie.recap: Nobody blinked, so the conductor shoved you both in to stop the shouting.

social.title: The Conductor's Gist
social.text: The danfo rolls out. The conductor has a friendly face, a long story and a say in who sits where, and the whole bus is listening to see who he likes.

stakes.default: Who the conductor backs for the rest of the ride.
stakes.coop: Keeping the conductor on your side.

twists.text: {holder} is already seated, dry and in a good mood.
{holder} has not been invited into the conversation.

choices.label: Laugh at his jokes and ask about his day
Offer to help him collect the fares
Tell him you were first and you want a discount
Quietly ask which seat is safest and what the fare really is

recap.default: {winner} has the conductor laughing and leaning on the headrest. {loser} is not invited into the joke.
recap.coop: You have the conductor laughing and firmly on your side.

recap.default: {winner} collects fares for him and gets a discount. {loser} pays full price and a tip for the trouble.
recap.coop: You help him collect and he knocks something off your fare.

recap.default: {winner} wins the argument and the whole bus hears about it. {loser} is quietly shown to the back.
recap.coop: You win the argument, loudly, and the bus noticed.

recap.default: {winner} learns which seat is safe and uses the ride to charge their phone. {loser} gets the leaky window.
recap.coop: You get the safe seats and a charger.

recap.default: Neither of you made a friend. The conductor turns up the radio.
recap.coop: He ignores you both and turns up the radio.

tie.recap: The conductor laughs at you both and shuffles you down the bus.

text.default: The danfo pulls off with one of you inside and the other hanging off the door frame, shoes on the step, rain starting. A market aunty is shouting about her tomatoes. The conductor is shouting at the wrong person.
text.coop: The danfo pulls off with the two of you half in and half out, shoes on the step, rain starting. A market aunty is shouting about her tomatoes.

stakes.default: Getting fully inside and keeping the good spot.
stakes.coop: Getting both of you fully inside.

twists.text: {holder} is hanging on with one hand.
{holder} already has a place on the bench.

choices.label: Beg the aunty to shift her basket
Haul yourself in by main force
Demand that the conductor stops the bus

lock.reason: You need both hands for the door.

choices.label: Shift your weight and climb in the safe way

recap.default: {winner} ends up on the dry bench. {loser} climbs in last and pays the conductor extra for the trouble.
recap.coop: You squeeze in, soaked but together.

recap.default: A basket tips over and a loud aunty blames you both.
recap.coop: A basket tips over and a loud aunty blames you both.

tie.recap: You both get in at the same time and the bus applauds sarcastically.

text.default: Forty people at the stop and every one of them has an opinion. The conductor folds his arms: whoever wins the crowd gets the seat. {rival} wants the whole stop on their side, not yours.
text.coop: Forty people at the stop and every one of them has an opinion. The conductor folds his arms: convince the crowd you belong on this bus, or walk.

stakes.coop: Getting the crowd to let you on.

twists.text: {holder} has the crowd's attention, for better or worse.
{holder} is getting dirty looks from the aunty selling pure water.

choices.label: Appeal to the aunty selling pure water
Pay the conductor extra and settle it
Double down: 'My uncle is a general!'
Point out that your fare is already paid

recap.default: {winner} wins the crowd and gets a cheer. {loser} gets silence and a few eye-rolls.
recap.coop: The crowd decides you are alright and makes space.

recap.default: The crowd boos you both and the rain finally arrives.
recap.coop: The crowd boos you both and the rain finally arrives.

tie.recap: The crowd cannot decide, so the conductor picks both of you to make it stop.

text.default: The danfo is gone and the rain is fully on. A keke driver pulls up with one seat and a price clearly inflated for the weather. {rival} already has a foot in.
text.coop: The danfo is gone and the rain is fully on. A keke driver pulls up with room for two and a price inflated for the weather.

stakes.default: The only dry seat in sight.
stakes.coop: A ride before the rain gets worse.

twists.text: The rain makes everything cost double and everything slippery.

choices.label: Negotiate the price with a smile
Jump in before he changes his mind
Tell him he is overcharging in the rain
Check he has working wipers and a licence first

recap.default: {winner} gets the dry keke seat. {loser} shelters under a shop awning, soaked.
recap.coop: You haggle him down and squeeze in, wet but moving.

recap.default: No keke for either of you, so you flag an okada and pay triple.
recap.coop: No keke, so you flag an okada together and pay triple.

tie.recap: He takes you both and charges double.

text.default: The man collecting the fare has just discovered that rain is a price increase. {rival} hears the same speech, and the whole ride is watching to see who pays and who argues.
text.coop: The man collecting the fare has just discovered that rain is a price increase. You and {partner} pool what you have, and it is not enough unless you play it smart.

twists.text: {holder} gets a wink from the conductor.
{holder} is counting coins with a worried face.
{holder} is holding notes and looking relaxed.
{holder} is already known to the whole bus.

choices.label: Haggle with humour
Pay fast and demand your change

lock.reason: You cannot pay fast with no cash.

choices.label: Raise your voice so the whole ride joins in
Count out the exact amount quietly

recap.default: {winner} haggles the fare down with a joke and the whole ride laughs. {loser} pays the full rain price.
recap.coop: You haggle the fare down with a joke and the whole ride laughs along.

recap.default: {winner}'s shouting wins the fare fight, and a LASTMA officer outside hears the commotion. {loser} wishes they had stayed quiet.
recap.coop: Your shouting works, but a LASTMA officer outside hears the commotion.

recap.default: {winner} sorts the fare out the smart way. {loser} pays the rain price and hears about it for the rest of the ride.
recap.coop: You sort the fare out quietly and keep your money.

recap.default: You both end up shouting about the price, and a LASTMA officer comes to see what the noise is.
recap.coop: The argument over the price gets loud, and a LASTMA officer comes to see why.

tie.recap: The man gives up and charges you both the same.

text.default: Traffic locks up on the flyover. Horns scream and ten minutes becomes forty. Your phone is at 4%, so is {rival}'s, and a passenger is selling charging time with one charge left.
text.coop: Traffic locks up on the flyover. Horns scream and ten minutes becomes forty. Both your phones are dying and one power bank has one charge left.

stakes.default: The last charge, and a working phone for the finish.
stakes.coop: Keeping a phone alive for the finish.

twists.text: {holder} can afford the last charge.
{holder} has nothing to pay with.

choices.label: Compliment the power-bank seller
Grab the cable and plug in first
Announce a family emergency to the whole bus
Switch to low-power mode and ration your battery

recap.default: {winner} announces an emergency so loudly that the whole bus hands over power banks. {loser} is embarrassed on their behalf.
recap.coop: You announce an emergency so loudly that the whole bus hands over power banks.

recap.default: {winner} keeps their phone alive. {loser}'s dies mid-sentence.
recap.coop: You keep a phone alive through the whole go-slow.

recap.default: The power bank dies and every phone goes dark.
recap.coop: The power bank dies and both phones go dark.

tie.recap: You share the last few percent between you.

text.default: A LASTMA officer in a reflective vest raps on the window. The bus will not move until someone deals with him, and whoever does earns the respect of the whole ride. {rival} is already leaning towards the door.
text.coop: A LASTMA officer in a reflective vest raps on the window. The bus will not move until someone deals with him, and your crew has to sort it before the whole bus turns on you.

stakes.default: The respect of the whole bus.

twists.text: The conductor vouches for {holder} from the front.
The officer has heard {holder} shouting.

choices.label: Greet the officer like an old friend
Offer a small something, quickly

lock.reason: You have nothing to offer him.

choices.label: Threaten to film him with your phone
Politely point out that the driver's papers are complete

recap.default: {winner} settles it and the whole bus applauds. {loser} gets an eye-roll from the aunty in front.
recap.coop: You settle it together and the bus cheers.

recap.default: The officer gets annoyed and the driver pays anyway, grumbling at you both.
recap.coop: The officer gets annoyed and the driver pays anyway, grumbling at you.

tie.recap: The officer waves the bus on out of boredom, so nobody gets the credit.

text.default: Yaba at last. The rain has stopped and the surprise party is ten minutes away. There is one okada left at the stop, and you and {rival} both spot it at the same time.
text.coop: Yaba at last. The rain has stopped and the doors close in ten minutes. One okada, one shortcut through the market, and you must get there together.

stakes.coop: Everyone through the door before it closes.

twists.text: The bus is still cheering {holder} out of the windows.
Half the bus is still muttering about {holder}.
{holder} has battery left and a map open.
{holder} has no phone and no idea where the shortcut goes.
The ground is still slippery.

choices.label: Sweet-talk the okada rider
Sprint for the bike
Block his path and shout 'I called him first!'
Forget the bike and take the shortcut through the market

endings.win: You rolled up to the party first, soaked and glorious, and by the time {loser} arrived your version of the story had been told twice.
endings.loss: You arrived last, soaked and holding somebody else's tomato. {winner} had already told the story.
endings.draw: You arrived at exactly the same moment, and nobody could say who won, so everyone argued about it all night.
endings.success: Against all odds, you both made it before the doors closed, wet but victorious.
endings.fail: The doors had already closed by the time you arrived. The party went on without you.

epilogues.text: The conductor texted {holder} later to ask how the party went.
{holder} was still being talked about on the 6:40 bus the next week.
{holder} now takes a different bus on Fridays.
{holder} found the party using directions shouted by strangers.
{holder} will never forget the view from the step.
